Epidemic phase

raw = read.csv("Data/raw_data.csv")
oracle <- raw %>%
  group_by(location, target_end_date) %>%
  slice_max(reference_date, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  distinct(location, target_end_date, oracle_value) %>%
  arrange(location, target_end_date)

trend_df <- oracle %>%
  group_by(location) %>%
  mutate(
    MA3        = rollmean(oracle_value, k = 3, fill = NA, align = "right"),
    pct_change = (MA3 - lag(MA3)) / lag(MA3) * 100,
    trend = case_when(
      pct_change > 5  ~ "Increasing",
      pct_change < -5 ~ "Decreasing",
      TRUE            ~ "Stable"
    ),
    trend = factor(trend, levels = c("Decreasing", "Stable", "Increasing"))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(location, target_end_date, trend)

standard_wis <- standard_wis %>%
  left_join(trend_df, by = c("location", "target_end_date"))

log_standard_wis <- log_standard_wis %>%
  left_join(trend_df, by = c("location", "target_end_date"))

sum(is.na(log_standard_wis$trend))

Granularity

state_locations <- c(
  "colorado", "georgia", "indiana", "maine", "maryland",
  "massachusetts", "minnesota", "north-carolina", "oregon",
  "south-carolina", "texas", "utah", "virginia"
)

standard_wis <- standard_wis %>%
  mutate(
    granularity = if_else(location %in% state_locations, "state", "local"),
    granularity = factor(granularity, levels = c("local", "state"))
  )

# table(standard_wis$granularity)
# standard_wis %>% distinct(location, granularity) %>% arrange(granularity, location)

# LOG
log_standard_wis <- log_standard_wis %>%
  mutate(
    granularity = if_else(location %in% state_locations, "state", "local"),
    granularity = factor(granularity, levels = c("local", "state"))
  )

Pop data

# county
counties_sf <- counties(cb = TRUE, year = 2022) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  dplyr::select(GEOID, STATEFP)

# OMB MSA delineation file
library(readxl)
## you can download this data from here https://www.census.gov/programs-surveys/metro-micro/about/delineation-files.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com
msa <- read_excel("Data/list1_2023.xlsx",skip = 2)
msa <- msa %>%
  mutate(
    GEOID = sprintf("%02d%03d",
                    as.numeric(`FIPS State Code`),
                    as.numeric(`FIPS County Code`))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(GEOID, `CBSA Code`)

# county → state → MSA 연결
state_msa <- counties_sf %>%
  left_join(msa, by = "GEOID") %>%
  filter(!is.na(`CBSA Code`))

# state별 MSA 개수
msa_count <- state_msa %>%
  group_by(STATEFP) %>%
  summarise(MSA_count = n_distinct(`CBSA Code`))

st_sf <- tigris::states(cb = TRUE, year = 2022)

st_name <- st_sf %>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
  dplyr::select(STATEFP, NAME) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

msa_count <- msa_count %>%
  left_join(st_name, by = "STATEFP") %>%
  rename(n_msa = MSA_count)
locations <- read.csv("Data/locations.csv")

state_pop <- get_acs(
  geography = "state",
  variables = "B01003_001",  # total population
  year = 2023,
  survey = "acs5",
  output = "wide"
) %>%
  dplyr::select(state = NAME, population = B01003_001E)
## Getting data from the 2019-2023 5-year ACS
standard_wis <- standard_wis %>%
  left_join(locations %>% 
              dplyr::select(state, location, population), 
            by = c("location")) %>% 
  left_join(state_pop, by = "state", suffix = c("",".state")) %>%
  left_join(msa_count %>%
              dplyr::select(-STATEFP), by = c("state" = "NAME")) %>%
  mutate(pop_ratio = population/population.state)

log_standard_wis <- log_standard_wis %>%
  left_join(locations %>% 
              dplyr::select(state, location, population), 
            by = c("location")) %>% 
  left_join(state_pop, by = "state", suffix = c("",".state")) %>%
  left_join(msa_count %>%
              dplyr::select(-STATEFP), by = c("state" = "NAME")) %>%
  mutate(pop_ratio = population/population.state)

standard_wis$trend <- relevel(
  factor(standard_wis$trend),
  ref = "Stable"
)

standard_wis$model_id <- relevel(
  factor(standard_wis$model_id),
  ref = "epiENGAGE-baseline"
)

standard_wis$granularity <- relevel(
  factor(standard_wis$granularity),
  ref = "state"
)

log_standard_wis$trend <- relevel(
  factor(log_standard_wis$trend),
  ref = "Stable"
)

log_standard_wis$model_id <- relevel(
  factor(log_standard_wis$model_id),
  ref = "epiENGAGE-baseline"
)

log_standard_wis$granularity <- relevel(
  factor(log_standard_wis$granularity),
  ref = "state"
)
wis_gamma <- glmmTMB(
  wis ~ model_id * (horizon + trend + granularity) +
    (1 | location) + (1 | target_end_date) + (1 | reference_date),
  dispformula = ~ model_id + horizon + trend + granularity,
  family = Gamma(link = "log"),
  data = standard_wis,
  control = glmmTMBControl(
    parallel = 4,
    optCtrl = list(iter.max = 2000, eval.max = 3000)
  )
)
summary(wis_gamma)

log1p_gamma <- glmmTMB(
  wis ~ model_id * (horizon + trend + granularity) +
    (1 | location) + (1 | target_end_date) + (1 | reference_date),
  dispformula = ~ model_id + horizon + trend + granularity,
  family = Gamma(link = "log"),
  data = log_standard_wis,
  control = glmmTMBControl(
    parallel = 4,
    optCtrl = list(iter.max = 2000, eval.max = 3000)
  )
)

summary(log1p_gamma)

Date random effects

maybe make this a figure? or just interesting by itself?

re <- ranef(wis_gamma)
re_target <- re$cond$target_end_date
re_ref    <- re$cond$reference_date
names(re_target)[1] <- "target"
names(re_ref)[1] <- "ref"

re_target$date <- rownames(re_target)
re_ref$date <- rownames(re_ref)

dates <- left_join(re_target, re_ref, by = "date")
dates = dates |> pivot_longer(names_to = "date_type", cols = c(target, ref))

dates$pct <- 100 * (exp(dates$value) - 1)
ggplot(dates, aes(x=date_type, y = factor(date, levels = rev(sort(unique(date)))), fill=value)) + geom_tile(col = "black") + 
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "forestgreen", mid = "grey90", high = "#d73027", midpoint = 0)  + 
  labs(x = "Date type", y = "Date", fill = "Random effect (log scale)") + theme_bw() + geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", value)), size = 3) 

ggplot(dates, aes(x=date_type, y = factor(date, levels = rev(sort(unique(date)))), fill=pct)) + geom_tile(col = "black") + 
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "forestgreen", mid = "grey90", high = "#d73027", midpoint = 0)  + 
  labs(x = "Date type", y = "Date", fill = "% change on WIS") + theme_bw() + geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", pct)), size = 3)

Estimates

add_ci <- function(x) {
  x |>
    mutate(
      ci_lower = est - 1.96 * se,
      ci_upper = est + 1.96 * se,
      pct_est   = 100 * (exp(est) - 1),
      pct_lower = 100 * (exp(ci_lower) - 1),
      pct_upper = 100 * (exp(ci_upper) - 1),
      excludes_zero = ci_lower > 0 | ci_upper < 0
    ) |>
    arrange(est)
}

fixed_effects <- as.data.frame(coef(summary(log1p_gamma))$cond) |> # HERE
  rownames_to_column("term") |>
  rename(est = Estimate, se = `Std. Error`) |>
  filter(term != "(Intercept)", !grepl(":", term)) |>
  add_ci()

make_ci_table <- function(variable) {
  fixed_effects |>
    filter(startsWith(term, variable)) |>
    mutate(
      !!variable := {
        level <- substring(term, nchar(variable) + 1)
        ifelse(level == "", "per 1-unit increase", level)
      },
      .before = 1
    ) |>
    select(-term)
}

model_id_ci    <- make_ci_table("model_id")
horizon_ci     <- make_ci_table("horizon")
trend_ci       <- make_ci_table("trend")
granularity_ci <- make_ci_table("granularity")

location_ci <- as.data.frame(ranef(log1p_gamma, condVar = TRUE)) |> # HERE
  filter(component == "cond", grpvar == "location", term == "(Intercept)") |>
  select(location = grp, est = condval, se = condsd) |>
  add_ci()

Subfigures

fig4a = ggplot(horizon_ci, aes(x = reorder(horizon, -pct_est), y = pct_est)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pct_lower, ymax = pct_upper), width = 0.2) + 
  geom_point(size = 5, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(y = "Fixed effect (% diff on WIS)", x = "Horizon") +
  theme_bw() +
  coord_flip() + 
  theme(
    text            = element_text(size = 27),
    axis.text.x     = element_text(size = 24),
    axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 24),
    axis.title      = element_text(size = 27),
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 24),
    legend.title    = element_text(size = 25.5),
    strip.text      = element_text(size = 25.5)
  )  
lookup = read.csv("Data/lookup.csv")
location_ci = location_ci |> left_join(lookup, by = "location")

location_ci$state_level = ifelse(location_ci$state == 'state', 'state', 'not-state')

location_ci = location_ci |> 
  mutate(state = ifelse(state == 'state', as.character(location), state))

state_order = location_ci |>
  distinct(location, state, pct_est) |>
  arrange(state, desc(pct_est))

location_ci = location_ci |> 
  arrange(desc(state_level == 'state'), state, pct_est) |> 
  mutate(location = factor(location, levels = state_order$location))

state_boundaries = which(diff(as.numeric(factor(state_order$state, 
                                                 levels = unique(state_order$state)))) != 0) + 0.5
fig4b = ggplot(location_ci, aes(x = location, y = pct_est, color = state)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = state_boundaries, color = "black", linewidth = 1.0) +
  geom_point(size = 5) +
  geom_point(data = subset(location_ci, state_level == "state"), 
             size = 5, shape = 21, fill = NA, color = "black", stroke = 1.5) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pct_lower, ymax = pct_upper), width = 0.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(x = "Location", y = "Random effect (% diff on WIS)") +
  theme_bw() +
  coord_flip() +
  theme(
    text            = element_text(size = 27),
    axis.text.x     = element_text(size = 24),
    axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 24),

    legend.text     = element_text(size = 24),
    legend.title    = element_text(size = 25.5),
    strip.text      = element_text(size = 25.5)
  )

  geom_point(color = "seagreen", size = 5) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(y = "Fixed effect (% diff on WIS)", x = "Model") +
  theme_bw() +
